boundary: Source checks, container runs and the owner's four-step ChatGPT Work test of 1.33.0; how ChatGPT or ChatGPT Work use the critique of 1.34.0 is not verified. All 201 planned cases remain not_run.

runs.delivered_aac: sound.py mix measures the delivered MP4: color-block -14.24 LUFS, -1.32 dBTP, no trim needed
runs.owner_test: ChatGPT Work, GPT 6.1 Sol, 1.33.0: four steps delivered and passed the technical checks; steps 1 to 3 approved by ear (PASS_REPORTED); step 4 (Bounce Party) rejected as a direction; findings fixed here: critique on delivered frames, measured AAC delivery, user choices recorded
runs.benchmark: docs/motion-benchmark and scripts/motion_benchmark.py added outside the package; not yet run across models (the owner stopped testing for now)
